metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.2 · 2011 · Goodnight for Justice
metas.description: When John Goodnight was a boy he watched in the weeds as his entire family was killed in a ruthless outlaw attack. Now as a circuit judge of the western territories Goodnight travels the west protecting the innocent from injustice.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.2 · 2012 · Goodnight for Justice: The Measure of a Man
metas.description: While traveling, a judge witnesses a gang robbing a bank and vows to bring the thieves to justice, but the case turns personal when one of the outlaws turns out to be the son of a widow he admires.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.3 · 2013 · Goodnight for Justice: Queen of Hearts
